Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Derrick White?

Derrick White is 32 years old.

Where was Derrick White born?

Derrick White was born in Parker, Colorado.

When was Derrick White born?

Derrick White was born on July 2, 1994.

How tall is Derrick White?

Derrick White is 6-4 (193 cm) tall.

How much does Derrick White weigh?

Derrick White weighs 190 lbs (86 kg).

Is Derrick White in the Hall of Fame?

Derrick White is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Derrick White drafted?

Derrick White was drafted by San Antonio Spurs, 1st round (29th pick, 29th overall), 2017 NBA Draft.

What position does Derrick White play?

Shooting Guard and Point Guard.

What is Derrick White's net worth?

Derrick White has made at least $107,136,124 playing professional basketball.

How much does Derrick White make?

Derrick White made $28,100,000 in 2026.

How many rings does Derrick White have?

Derrick White has won one championship.

What is Derrick White's Instagram account?

Derrick White is on Instagram at dwhite921.

What schools did Derrick White attend?

Derrick White attended Legend in Parker, Colorado, Colorado-Colorado Springs and Colorado.

What are Derrick White's nicknames?

The Buffalo is a nickname for Derrick White.
